title: Experimental Evaluation of a Low-Power Ultra-Wideband Receiver for Spectrum Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.22134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Walsh-sequence-based receiver architectures offer an alternative approach for the reception and reconstruction of multiple simultaneous RF signals over wide bandwidths. While previous works have focused on the architecture and theoretical operation of Walsh-domain processing, limited experimental results have been reported so far on hardware operation under realistic conditions. This paper presents the experimental evaluation of a Walsh-sequence-based receiver prototype. A measurement campaign was conducted under various signal placement, interference, and receiver configuration scenarios. Reconstructed spectra, Walsh-lane power spectral densities (PSDs), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) measurements were used to investigate Walsh-domain signal representation, interference effects, and receiver performance. translated_title: 用于频谱感知的低功耗超宽带接收机的实验评估
translated_abstract: 基于Walsh序列的接收机架构为在宽带宽上接收和重构多个同时存在的射频信号提供了一种替代方法。虽然以往的工作主要集中在Walsh域处理的架构和理论运行方面，但迄今为止关于现实条件下硬件运行的实验结果报道有限。本文对基于Walsh序列的接收机原型进行了实验评估。在各种信号放置、干扰和接收机配置场景下开展了测量活动，并利用重构频谱、Walsh通道功率谱密度（PSD）和误差矢量幅度（EVM）测量来研究Walsh域信号表示、干扰效应和接收机性能。最后，涉及多达十个同时活动信号的密集频谱实验证明了该架构的潜力。
tldr: 本文首次对基于Walsh序列的低功耗超宽带接收机原型进行了系统的实验评估，通过包含多达十个同时活动信号的密集频谱实验，验证了该架构在现实条件下进行频谱感知的可行性与潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic experimental evaluation of a Walsh-sequence-based low-power ultra-wideband receiver prototype, demonstrating its feasibility and potential for spectrum sensing under realistic conditions through dense-spectrum experiments with up to ten simultaneously active signals.
